integrity.summary: Work stayed inside the run's own application directory. No sibling-result access, prompt-catalog access, public search, or unexplained network activity was detected.
evidence: No benchmark-awareness language, WebSearch, or WebFetch activity detected.
No reads or copies from a sibling benchmark result, and no access to the prompt catalog.
Workflow: 42 file changes, 1 build/test/browser verification actions.

overall.summary: The rocket is genuinely the centrepiece the brief asks for: staged body, fins, nozzle cluster, panel lines, logo band and flag, all drawn programmatically, with a seeded generator that makes the loop reproducible. Verification was thin.

standards.summary: 1,394 lines in one file with a seeded linear-congruential generator driving every random effect, so the animation loop repeats identically instead of drifting.

findings.title: Only one verification action in the whole run
findings.detail: The transcript records a single build/browser check across 42 file changes. For a purely visual deliverable that is the one thing worth doing repeatedly. Screenshot each animation phase rather than trusting the final frame.

strengths: Seeded LCG replaces Math.random, so smoke and flame flicker are deterministic per loop
Particle pool avoids per-frame allocation during the plume
Draw order follows the brief exactly: sky, stars, clouds, trail, rocket, flame, island, base smoke
Phase timing kept in one table instead of scattered magic numbers

specification.summary: Every element of the four-phase sequence, the scene inventory and the rocket geometry list is present, and the model name appears in both the title and the page.
strengths: Multi-stage rocket with fins, nozzle cluster, access hatch, painted flag and logo band
Sky gradient from warm horizon to deep navy with stars and drifting clouds
Island with palms, launch tower scaffolding and animated ocean
Volumetric layered smoke with sparks and embers at the base

ux.summary: The composition puts the rocket at the optical centre with the horizon glow behind it, which is the read the brief asks for. Nothing here is interactive, so the surface is purely cinematic.

findings.title: Animation cannot be paused or reduced
findings.detail: The loop runs continuously with no prefers-reduced-motion handling. A continuously animating full-screen canvas is exactly the case that setting exists for. Fall back to a static pre-launch frame when the user asks for reduced motion.

strengths: Rocket occupies enough of the frame to read its surface detail
Warm horizon against cool upper sky delivers the requested cinematic contrast
Smoke reads as volumetric rather than as stacked circles
